name: Home Screen Sections Encore
overview: Modular home screen sections for Jellyfin 12.4 (fork of Home Screen Sections).
description: Fork of Home Screen Sections (IAmParadox27) for Jellyfin 12.4. Modular home screen sections configured by the server admin. The minified names it needs from jellyfin-web are found in the served bundle, so a new Jellyfin version does not leave the home screen blank. Requires File Transformation.

versions.changelog: Let only the newest load of a page draw. Clear the rows of the previous page at once. Redraw a page left without visible rows.
Stop holding clicks after moving between library and collection pages. Going back keeps the rows, their order and the height of the page.
Open Movies, Shows, Anime and Collections in the home format, with rows and banner scoped to each library. Collection pages get the same layout. See all opens the native grid.
fix(sections): do not keep an empty catalog for a day
Genre rows with several words in the title no longer disappear
Faster home page: the available genres are only checked once a day
Genre rows that need no watch history, treating genre names in several languages as one
- Admin page: sections it does not know yet start disabled and admin-locked (saving the page used to enable every section).
- Report the real plugin version to Jellyfin (it showed 3.0.0.0), so updates are offered.

First Encore release, based on Home Screen Sections 3.0.3 (main at 288a1f6).
- Runs on Jellyfin 12.4: the web client hook names are found in the served bundle; the stock home screen is kept if one is missing.
- Fixed the library buttons icon helper on 12.x.
- Own GUID, name and assembly (Jellyfin.Plugin.HomeScreenSectionsEncore).

name: Media Bar Encore
overview: Immersive home screen slideshow with video backdrops (fork of Media Bar Enhanced).
description: Fork of Media Bar Enhanced (CodeDevMLH), itself a fork of MakD's Media Bar. Same full-width slideshow with trailer backdrops, plus Encore additions: the slideshow and trailer pause while the banner is scrolled out of view. Requires File Transformation when the web files are read-only.

versions.changelog: Load the data of all slides in one request. Skip the search for local trailers when a remote one exists. Show the banner as soon as its first slide is ready.
Hide slides, dots and timer of the previous page as soon as the page changes. Prepare the slide lists of libraries and collections in the background.
Change the slides when the user moves to another page while the banner is still loading for the first time.
Keep the pause across pages and out of view. Remove the banner from the Collections page. Open pages with a saved slide list, checked against the library. Add the Dot Carousel option.
Take the slides from the library or collection page being viewed. A failed trailer now behaves as a slide without trailer.
fix(trailer): treat a failed trailer as a slide without trailer
Trailer fade-in back to the original timing: the delay needs more testing
The trailer fades in 3 s later, after YouTube's own pause icon is gone
Slides no longer advance while the banner is out of view; a pause now stops a trailer that was still loading

First Encore release, based on Media Bar Enhanced 3.11.1.
- The slideshow and the trailer pause while the banner is scrolled out of view.
- Own GUID, name and assembly (Jellyfin.Plugin.MediaBarEncore). Replaces Media Bar Enhanced: uninstall it first.

name: Fin Tweaks
overview: Small web client tweaks, each one with its own switch.
description: Small fixes to the Jellyfin web client, each one with its own switch in the admin page. Only the tweaks turned on are sent to the browser. Requires File Transformation.

versions.changelog: Add the wheel axis lock: the start of a gesture over a row decides between scrolling the row and the page. Off by default.

First release.
- Global search: the search button always searches the whole server.
